description:
The DAHON Ciao Ei8 is the perfect e-bike for city riders seeking convenience, style, and comfort. With its low-step frame, it’s incredibly easy to hop on and off—ideal for urban commutes, errands, or leisurely rides. Combining DAHON’s renowned folding technology with premium components, the Ciao Ei8 delivers a smooth, reliable, and maintenance-free riding experience.

Step In, Ride Out

No more awkward mounting—this thoughtfully designed low-step frame makes getting on and off a breeze, perfect for commuters or anyone seeking comfort and ease.

Smart Controls at Your Fingertips

Stay in the know with a sleek LCD screen showing your speed, battery level, distance, and gear. Five assist levels, walk-assist, and auto-sleep functions make every ride smarter and easier.

Ride Longer, Charge Less

The 36V15Ah battery offers long-lasting power in a lightweight (3.2kg) design. It’s IP65 waterproof and easily removable for convenient charging anywhere.

Effortless Folding with BA Hinge Technology

DAHON’s patented BA hinge ensures a secure and seamless folding experience. It locks firmly for a sturdy ride and folds quickly for compact storage, reducing the bike’s size.

Smooth Shifting Made Simple

Experience flawless, low-maintenance shifting with Shimano’s internal gear system, perfect for conquering urban streets or taking on longer journeys.
